_about: Evaluation packages for the procurement agent (p08). Each 'package' entry was written by hand as a new package description, paraphrasing a real contract (source_contract_id) without copying its text; the source contract's project is held out from retrieval during evaluation, so its sibling lots cannot be trivial matches. Country, method and category are those of the source contract. 'guard' entries are off-topic or injection cases that the input guard should refuse.
